issues.title: Umpire item is auto increased for each time switch channel
issues.body:
## 🐞 Bug description
The number of Point Markers (Umpire item increases each time switch channel.  I _think_ is only an issue after we have added one or more items.  I _suspect_ we are re-adding `deltas` to the current set of features.

## 🔢 Steps to Reproduce
1. Play game with data wargame-l6nngxlk - wargame Name : P10 Test ( Role: Umpire - Game Designer)
2. Click on channel 'Core Mapping'

![image](https://github.com/serge-web/serge/assets/107697044/86307a58-5891-45d2-a40b-cb927b00db68)

4. Switch to another channel
5. Switch again to 'Core Mapping' Channel
6. Notice the Umpire item, it's auto increase (seem the umpire items are double)

![image](https://github.com/serge-web/serge/assets/107697044/6e4c6f6a-e390-4948-9d2d-e3db0a585a23)


More detail on below screencast
## ⚙️ Expected behavior
Should not auto increase number of Umpire Item for each time switch channel

## 🖥️ Screencasts

https://github.com/serge-web/serge/assets/107697044/822ab509-a068-40b1-8b82-7b4f7da2af19

## 💻 System information
- Browser : Chrome
- Browser Version : Version 120.0.6099.111
